data.gender_notes: Shivpujan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Shivpujan is a combination of two words - Shiv and Pujan. Shiv refers to Lord Shiva, the Hindu god of destruction and creation. Pujan means worship or reverence. Thus, the name Shivpujan signifies the act of worshipping Lord Shiva. The name Shivpujan carries the meaning “Worship of Shiva” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Shivpujan usually hope their child will grow to embody worship of shiva and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Shivpujan is a sacred name that represents devotion and dedication to Lord Shiva. It is a name that inspires spiritual growth and a deep connection with the divine.
data.etymology: Shivpujan belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Worship of Shiva.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Shivpujan total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
